description: Show the evaluation history of one scheduler job — each tick's status, message, and timing.

id.description: The job id whose history to fetch (e.g. job_3f9c1a).

limit.description: Max records to return. Omit (or 0) for the server default.

since.description: Only records at or after this RFC3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-07-06T00:00:00Z).
